description: Intended fictional demo companies for scripts/seed/demo-activate.mjs. Built by --write-manifest from repo sources (fictional-bulk seed-state + world, tavus-20 seed-state, dev fictional world, packages/q-pitch demo companies, the 13 Nov acceptance matrix) plus a read-only lookup of the dev world's founder companies. Membership here is intent only: every company is re-checked at run time and refused unless every attached person is fictional. Excluded on purpose: real demonstration companies (demonstration_data = true; owner 13 Nov: they stay as they are), the rest of the real-companies seed (MoneyHash and ekko are in by owner decision 13 Nov), and the live e2e release-test companies (e.g. Ledgerline UIFK (fictional), kept for the human four-eyes verification test).
